dct_creator_sm: Canadian Parks and Wilderness Society (CPAWS) Yukon.
dct_description_sm: CPAWS engaged that EDI Environmental Dynamics Inc. (EDI) to complete a one-time water quality sampling event to investigate whether any potential contaminants from the historical Range Road landfill are impacting water quality in McIntyre Creek. This sampling event was scheduled to occur on May 27, 2023, prior to a planned McIntyre Creek community clean up event.
dct_title_s: CPAWS Yukon Range Road Water Sampling
